approach.input_code:
local m=emu.memType.nesInternalRam
local scroll=emu.read(0x60,m)+256*emu.read(0x61,m)
local st=emu.read(0x300,m)
local magic=emu.read(0x490,m)
if not phase then phase=0;at=0;oldMagic=magic end
local keys={}
if frame<170 then
 keys.select=(frame>=20 and frame<24)or(frame>=155 and frame<159)
 keys.b=frame>=50 and frame<54
else
 local f=frame-150
 keys.right=(f<300)or(f>=600 and f<900)or(f>=1200 and f<1500)
 keys.left=(f>=300 and f<600)or(f>=900 and f<1200)
 keys.b=frame%20<3
 if scroll>=350 and scroll<=512 and phase==0 and st<2 then phase=1;at=frame;oldMagic=magic end
 if phase==1 then
  keys={select=frame-at<4,b=frame-at>=8 and frame%12<3}
  if magic<oldMagic then phase=2;at=frame end
 elseif phase==2 then
  keys={}
  if frame-at>=110 then phase=3;at=frame end
 elseif phase==3 then
  keys={select=frame-at<4}
  if frame-at>=5 then phase=4 end
 elseif phase==4 and scroll>=480 and scroll<=512 then
  keys={right=true,b=frame%20<3,a=frame%100<35}
 end
end
emu.setInput(keys,0)
